title: Payroll journal entry from the gross-to-net report
prompt: Prepare the monthly payroll journal entry from the gross-to-net payroll report using approved account and department mappings.
keywords: last pay date (period rule stand-in: business_day)
comment: Trigger period rule: the library has no last_pay_date rule yet, so business_day stands in; the pay period itself comes from the payCalendar setup answer and the register dates. Runs on the payroll.pay_run event or on request.

setup.q: Which ledger account and department does each payroll line (wages, employer taxes, benefits, withholdings, net pay) post to?
Which ledger account is the payroll clearing or payroll funding account?

inputs.name: Gross-to-net payroll export for the pay period
Payroll account and department mapping workbook
Payroll funding report for the pay period

steps: run column_map over the gross-to-net export (headers never positions) and save the mapping to data/gross-to-net-columns.json
apply the approved account and department mapping to each payroll line; a line with no mapping is an exception, never guessed
build the entry: debits for wages, employer taxes and benefits by department; credits for withholdings payable, benefits payable and the cash or clearing credit
read the funding report total; write data/payroll-entry.json with cashCredit, fundingTotal and cashCreditLessFunding
propose the journal entry (tier B from uploaded reports; tier A when the payroll provider is connected and the mapping is approved)
write the workbook with totals by account and department only; no employee-level figures

done.text: The proposed payroll entry balances to the penny
The gross-to-net export columns were mapped by header with no ambiguous or missing required column
The cash or clearing credit in the entry equals the funding report total (the difference recorded in data/payroll-entry.json is 0.00)
Every exception row cites the report line and the mapping row
payroll-journal-entry.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every entry line traces to a report column and a mapping row; the deliverable carries totals by account and department only, with no employee name or pay

tierRules.when: the payroll provider is connected and the figures and mapping come from the connection and the approved workbook
the figures come from an uploaded gross-to-net report
